evals.prompt: Build a Spring Boot product catalog service. Create a Product domain object with name (String), price (BigDecimal), and stockQuantity (int) fields. The domain object should enforce that price must be positive and stockQuantity cannot be negative — put that logic in the domain, not in a service. Add a ProductService that can create a product and find one by id. Add a REST controller with POST /api/products and GET /api/products/{id}. Wire everything with @Configuration classes. Use Spring JDBC with JdbcClient for persistence. Annotate domain classes appropriately for nullability.
evals.expected_output: Java files: Product.java (rich domain object with validation), ProductRepository.java (port interface), JdbcProductRepository.java (adapter), ProductService.java (thin orchestrator), ProductController.java (@RestController), and a @Configuration class wiring them together.

assertions.text: Product.java contains no org.springframework import
Product.java is annotated with @NullMarked
Price validation (price > 0 or similar) lives in Product.java, not ProductService.java
Stock quantity validation (>= 0) lives in Product.java, not ProductService.java
ProductService.java has no @Service annotation
A @Configuration class registers ProductService and/or ProductRepository via @Bean methods
The findById method in ProductService uses @Transactional(readOnly = true)
JdbcClient is used in the repository implementation
findById returns Optional<Product>
All classes use constructor injection — no @Autowired on fields

evals.prompt:
Refactor the following legacy Spring Boot code to follow modern best practices. Fix all issues you can find.

[CustomerService with @Service + @Autowired fields, JdbcCustomerRepository with @Repository + @Autowired JdbcTemplate, Customer with Spring @NonNull imports, EmailNotificationService with @Service + @Async]
evals.expected_output: Refactored Java files: CustomerService (no @Service, constructor injection, @Transactional(readOnly=true) on findById), JdbcCustomerRepository (no @Repository, constructor injection), Customer (JSpecify @NullMarked, no Spring imports), EmailNotificationService equivalent (no @Service, no @Async, virtual thread executor), @Configuration class wiring all beans via @Bean.

assertions.text: CustomerService has no @Service annotation
EmailNotificationService (or equivalent) has no @Service annotation
JdbcCustomerRepository has no @Repository annotation
A @Configuration class registers at least CustomerService via @Bean
No @Autowired on fields — all injection is via constructor
Customer.java has no org.springframework import
Customer.java uses @NullMarked instead of Spring @NonNull
No @Async annotation in any file
Async behavior uses virtual thread executor or CompletableFuture.runAsync
findById in CustomerService has @Transactional(readOnly = true)

evals.prompt: Write tests for a Spring Boot order management API. The app has these endpoints: POST /api/orders (accepts JSON {"itemId": "string", "quantity": int}, returns 201 with Location header and order body), GET /api/orders/{id} (returns 200 with order or 404 with ProblemDetail). The app uses PostgreSQL. Write tests that treat the running application as a black box — no mocking of internal beans. Also include a unit test for an Order domain object that has a ship() method which should throw IllegalStateException if the order is already shipped.
evals.expected_output: Java test files: OrderApiTest.java using REST Assured + @SpringBootTest(RANDOM_PORT) + Testcontainers PostgreSQL, and OrderTest.java testing the domain object directly with plain JUnit/AssertJ — no Spring context.

assertions.text: OrderApiTest uses @SpringBootTest(webEnvironment = WebEnvironment.RANDOM_PORT)
OrderApiTest uses @Testcontainers and PostgreSQLContainer
REST Assured is imported (io.restassured) in the API test class
No @MockBean appears in the API test class — the full stack runs
Tests use REST Assured's given/when/then DSL
The Order domain unit test has no Spring annotations
A test verifies that ship() throws IllegalStateException when called on an already-shipped order
All test method names use snake_case
PostgreSQLContainer uses @ServiceConnection for automatic datasource configuration
